name: detail-D-opening_perimeter-PLANT_INT_2X6_B-d36811

nodes.content: CASING 3/4" x 3 1/2" pvc-trim, 3/16" REVEAL TO JAMB

notes: • Room at 75 F / 70% RH; dew point 64.4 F.
• Liner, inside out: 1/2" PVC panel, 3/4" furring, membrane. Walls and ceiling.
• The membrane is the air and vapour barrier. Continuous on all six sides.
• Floor: SurePly + seamless sheet; 4" rubber base, silicone toe. No drain.
• Glazing: fixed units only, U-0.14, warm-edge spacer, thermally broken frame.
• No suspended ceiling. No roofing membrane under the vinyl.
• Ventilation: 25 cfm in, 25 cfm out, both dampered. Extract high, far end.
• Damp location throughout; wet location wherever misted or hosed.
• Liner trim laps the rubber base, sealed; weep kept open (K4).
• Sloped pan over the stool, flashed to the membrane; drains to the room.
• Wet-location listed luminaires, gasketed, corrosion-resistant housings.
• Receptacles WR-listed and GFCI, in non-metallic gasketed boxes with in-use covers.
• Grow tubes listed to UL 8800 per NEC Article 410 Part XVI.
K2  Membrane continuous wall to ceiling; seal each penetration.
K4  Keep the 3/4" furring gap open behind the panel; it is the drying path.
